Adding the actionable network checks to paste into the runbook. These are intentionally minimal so Aurelius can run them from their edge router quickly:

- BGP quick: show ip bgp summary | grep Established  # expect remote ASN and Established on both transit peers
- Latency/lightpath: mtr -c 30 -i 0.5 -r 10.2.0.12  (collect packet-loss and avg latency; fail if loss > 1%)
- Control-plane TLS: curl -sv https://mgmt.internal.redwood:8443/healthz --resolve mgmt.internal.redwood:8443:10.2.0.12  # expect HTTP 200 and TLS handshake success
- ACL acceptance: tcpdump -n -i eth0 'host 10.2.0.12 and port 443' (run while curl above executes; expect SYN/ACK reply)

Also adding a tiny priming step for KV cache: run two warmup requests per node with consistent prompt to seed KV for the canary path. I'll append exact curl examples to the runbook PDF.

-Mina
